text:
Ivy (Finance): Quick heads-up: updated travel & conference procurement rules live today. A few new caps + a streamlined pre-approval flow for marketing events. TL;DR below.

Lina (Marketing): TL;DR? We have two booth reservations pending.

Ivy (Finance): TL;DR: 1) Conference booth / sponsorship approvals: auto-approve up to $5k; $5k-20k needs Marketing lead + Finance sign-off; >$20k requires Director review. 2) Travel: economy for flights <6h; premium economy or business requires pre-approval for >$1,000 incremental. 3) Per diem: domestic meals cap $75/day, international $120/day. 4) All bookings & receipts must go through Travel Portal (link below). 5) Fast-path for customer-impacting events: use `conf-fasttrack` tag for 2-hour triage.

Omar (Sales): For sponsor packages with booth + sponsor dinner bundled (often $18k), is that treated as one approval?

Priya (Finance Partner): Yes 1 treat bundled packages as single procurement lines. If total <=20k, Marketing lead + Finance sign-off is enough. If vendor invoices in installments, include full contract value in the request.

Lina (Marketing): We're doing a booth in EU. Any extra approvals for international booths?

Ivy (Finance): International booths: include customs/shipping estimate and local VAT treatment in the request. Also note estimated FX fees. If total spend crosses $20k after FX, that'll need Director review.

Omar (Sales): For customer dinners tied to conferences, do meals still need itemized receipts and guest list?

Priya (Finance Partner): Yes 1 itemized receipts + attendee names and business purpose required. Meals count against per diem unless pre-approved as entertainment (then attach justification).

Lina (Marketing): Is there a template for approvals? Makes it easier to send to Finance.

Ivy (Finance): Use this subject + body format for requests:```
Subject: Travel/Conf Approval - [Team] - [Event] - [Total $]
Body: event link, contract/vendor, estimated total (incl. shipping/VAT), business justification (1 paragraph), marketing contact
```

travel-bot: New travel request created: #7789 (submitted by lina.marketing). Status: pending. Attachments: booth-contract.pdf

Lina (Marketing): Uploaded contract and shipping estimate. Thanks.

Ivy (Finance): Operational notes: (a) All bookings should use approved vendors in the Travel Portal to ensure corporate rates and insurance. (b) Per diem reimbursements paid on expense report; card charges count against daily cap. (c) Fast-path `conf-fasttrack` reserved for events with active customer commitments or revenue impact.

Omar (Sales): How long to expect for normal review? We usually need confirmations 2-3 weeks prior.

Ivy (Finance): Standard SLA: reviews <=5k = 48 hours; 5k-20k = 3 business days; >20k = 5 business days. Fast-path is ~2 hours business-hours. Submit earlier when possible.

Priya (Finance Partner): Reminder: sponsorships and booth invoices must include W9/W8 and vendor questionnaire for onboarding if new vendor >$5k. That avoids onboarding delays.

approvals-bot: Reminder: request #7789 missing W9. Please attach within 72h to avoid delays.

Lina (Marketing): Adding W8 for the EU vendor now.

Ivy (Finance): We're publishing a 1-page checklist to #docs and the intranet travel page. Also running a 20-min Q&A Thursday 9:30am PT. Please bring specific vendor/scenario questions.

Omar (Sales): Appreciate this  helps sync expectations with Marketing.

Ivy (Finance): Thanks all. If you have customer-impacting events this quarter, tag `conf-fasttrack` on the portal or DM Priya/Ivy directly.
